title: Verificar round-trip patente → guide → request durable
mission: Independently verify the new page-plate continuity path without publishing a fake user page. Resolve CAL001 and VOZ001 from canonical registries; verify stable context handles, public /g and /wc bindings, unique AAA000 allocation law, and Live projection. Materialize one bounded synthetic INSPECT/no_page page-request canary using CAL001+VOZ001 with deterministic dedupe and append-only evidence, then verify a second contender would converge/dedupe rather than fork. Do not mutate the Calendar or Voice pages. Return exact evidence and fix bounded protocol/UI defects with CAS when safe.
definition_of_done: Every current Live page has one unique AAA000 plate and deterministic context_path.
CAL001 and VOZ001 resolve identically through PLATE_REGISTRY_V1.json and PAGE_WATCH_REGISTRY_V1.json.
Public /g is bound to PAGE_PLATE_PROTOCOL_V1 + PAGE_REQUEST_PUBLICATION_PROTOCOL_V1 and can interpret one or more page plates.
Public /wc is bound to the same identity/publication laws for page-scoped worker work.
A deterministic synthetic inspect/no_page request for CAL001+VOZ001 is created exactly once and includes literal intent, source plates, acceptance, authority boundary and dedupe key.
A simulated/actual second contender converges on the same request identity or detects the existing request rather than creating a duplicate.
No existing page bytes or page identities are mutated by the canary.
Live page shelf exposes plate text from live/pages.json and page plate remains distinct from P### change IDs.
Result remains canary evidence; no claim that new-page publication is operational until a real new-page request completes reserve→build→verify→publish→registry.
